en-US.description: A full-featured desktop app for Hermes Agent.
en-US.longDescription:
A full-featured desktop app and web dashboard for Hermes Agent.
Manage AI chat sessions, monitor usage & costs, configure platform channels,
schedule cron jobs, browse skills — all from a clean, responsive web interface.

zh-CN.description: Hermes Agent 的全功能桌面应用
zh-CN.longDescription:
Hermes Agent 的全功能桌面应用和 Web 管理面板。
管理 AI 聊天会话、监控用量与成本、配置平台渠道、
管理定时任务、浏览技能 —— 全部在一个简洁响应式的 Web 界面中完成。
zh-CN.name: Hermes Studio
zh-CN.releaseNotes:
更新内容
- 新增 DeepSeek Harness（DSH）安装管理及单聊、群聊和工作流接入，支持选择 Agent 预设并在恢复会话时保留原有模式；同步中英文使用说明 (#3020, #3023)
- 新增 DSH 原生 Web 插件配置、插件列表和 Agent 预设管理，支持复制预设、设置默认项及删除自定义预设；需在后端主机安装 DSH 和 Web 依赖 (#3020)
- 群聊 Agent 新建和编辑改为右侧抽屉，表单可滚动、操作按钮固定，移动端使用全屏宽度 (#3020)
- 所有 Coding Agent 页面中的共享技能改为只读，防止误编辑或删除；DSH 私有技能仍可编辑 (#3020)
- Pi 安装和更新跟随 npm 最新版本，优先使用用户已启用的 MCP 适配器，避免重复注册工具和参数 (#2999, #2991)
- 修复全局 Coding Agent 用量统计和模型归属，保留已完成响应的用量并改进缓存 Token 统计；历史记录不回填 (#3005)
- 修复 Grok 失败轮次用量丢失、自定义服务商上下文范围，以及修改推理强度后运行配置未刷新的问题 (#3002)
- Docker 中通过 Studio 安装的 Coding Agent 随 Studio 数据卷持久保存，重建或更新容器后不再丢失；旧镜像安装的 Agent 需重新安装一次 (#3006)
- 隐藏 OpenCode 不支持的 /compact 命令，手动输入时给出说明且不打断当前任务 (#3010)
- 修复 Hermes Agent 0.21 及后续版本的审批会话关联，兼容旧版运行时 (#3018)
- 将 apikey 默认域名更新为 apikey.fan，启动时一次性迁移已有 Hermes 配置中的旧端点，保留路径、密钥和模型设置 (#3022)
- 优化 Linux 启动器和窗口图标的圆角与透明留白，使显示尺寸更协调 (#3008)
What's Changed
- fix(coding-agent): follow latest Pi package versions by @wtj-0527 in https://github.com/EKKOLearnAI/hermes-studio/pull/2999
- fix(coding-agents): skip bundled Pi MCP adapter when user installs their own by @Swartea in https://github.com/EKKOLearnAI/hermes-studio/pull/2991
- fix: preserve usage and refresh Grok session settings by @lorenzozanee in https://github.com/EKKOLearnAI/hermes-studio/pull/3002
- fix: record native global agent usage and model attribution by @EKKOLearnAI in https://github.com/EKKOLearnAI/hermes-studio/pull/3005
- fix: persist coding agent installations across Docker recreation by @EKKOLearnAI in https://github.com/EKKOLearnAI/hermes-studio/pull/3006
- [codex] fix Linux app icon shape and visual size by @EKKOLearnAI in https://github.com/EKKOLearnAI/hermes-studio/pull/3008
- fix: remove unsupported OpenCode /compact command by @EKKOLearnAI in https://github.com/EKKOLearnAI/hermes-studio/pull/3010
- fix(bridge): import session-key helpers from tools.approval_context with fallback by @3617916-creator in https://github.com/EKKOLearnAI/hermes-studio/pull/3018
- feat: integrate DSH chats, Web plugins and Agent presets by @EKKOLearnAI in https://github.com/EKKOLearnAI/hermes-studio/pull/3020
- fix: update apikey domains with one-time startup tasks by @EKKOLearnAI in https://github.com/EKKOLearnAI/hermes-studio/pull/3022
- docs: document DSH support in both READMEs by @EKKOLearnAI in https://github.com/EKKOLearnAI/hermes-studio/pull/3023
- chore: release 0.7.20 with localized frontend changelog by @EKKOLearnAI in https://github.com/EKKOLearnAI/hermes-studio/pull/3024
New Contributors
- @Swartea made their first contribution in https://github.com/EKKOLearnAI/hermes-studio/pull/2991
- @3617916-creator made their first contribution in https://github.com/EKKOLearnAI/hermes-studio/pull/3018
Full Changelog: https://github.com/EKKOLearnAI/hermes-studio/compare/v0.7.19...v0.7.20
